en.title: Tony Hale Returns as Forky for Toy Story 5: What We Know
en.summary: The beloved, existential spork voiced by Tony Hale is back for Toy Story 5. Directed by Andrew Stanton, the film is set to explore new challenges for Bonnie's toys.
en.body:
Get ready to embrace the existential dread and delightful quirkiness once more! **Tony Hale** is officially returning to the **Toy Story** universe as the voice of **Forky** in **Toy Story 5**. This highly anticipated sequel, helmed by **Andrew Stanton**, promises to delve into the evolving landscape of childhood and play, a theme that has been central to the franchise since its inception.

Forky, the handmade spork who famously grappled with his purpose and identity in *Toy Story 4*, perfectly embodied the series' knack for exploring profound themes through simple, relatable characters. Crafted from pipe cleaners and popsicle sticks, Forky’s journey from trash to treasured toy resonated deeply, capturing the essence of new beginnings and the anxieties that come with them. Hale's performance, a masterful blend of terror and wide-eyed wonder, brought this unique character to life, leading to his own Disney+ series, *Forky Asks a Question?*.

## The Existential Spork's New Challenge

In **Toy Story 5**, Bonnie's cherished toys will face a new frontier: the rise of smart technology. The teaser hints that the focus will shift to **Jessie**, voiced by **Joan Cusack**, as she navigates her place in Bonnie's life amidst the allure of new digital companions. With the introduction of **Lilypad**, a new iPad-like device voiced by **Greta Lee**, the film is poised to explore how technology impacts the very nature of play and imagination in a child's world. This new conflict promises to test the enduring bonds of friendship and the timeless magic of classic toys.

## A Franchise Milestone

The return of **Forky** and the continuation of the **Toy Story** saga marks another significant chapter for Pixar and Disney. The franchise has consistently delivered heartwarming stories that appeal to both children and adults, becoming a cornerstone of animated cinema. With **Toy Story 5**, the film is expected to join the ranks of other major franchises like *Star Wars*, *Avengers*, and *Avatar* by potentially achieving three billion-dollar films at the box office. The anticipation is palpable for fans eager to see how this beloved series will tackle contemporary themes.

## What's Next

**Toy Story 5** is slated for a theatrical release on **June 19, 2026**. Fans can look forward to more details about the plot and the full voice cast as the release date approaches.

tr.title: Toy Story 5'te Forky'nin Dönüşü: Bilmeniz Gereken Her Şey
tr.summary: Sevgili, varoluşsal çatışmalara sahip çatal-kaşık Forky, Toy Story 5'te geri dönüyor. Andrew Stanton'ın yönettiği film, Bonnie'nin oyuncaklarının yeni zorluklarla karşılaşacağı bir dünyayı keşfedecek. Toy Story serisinin temel teması olan çocukluk ve oyunun değişen dünyasını keşfedecek.
tr.body:
Toy Story 5'te Forky'nin Dönüşü

Toy Story evrenine geri dönmeye hazır mısınız? **Tony Hale**, **Toy Story 5**'te **Forky** karakterinin seslendirmesini yapacak. **Andrew Stanton**'ın yönettiği bu çok beklenen devam filmi, çocukluk ve oyunun değişen dünyasını keşfedecek. Forky, *Toy Story 4*'te kendi amacını ve kimliğini sorgulayan, boru temizleyicileri ve çöpçülerden yapılan bir çatal-kaşık olarak ortaya çıktı. Hale'in performansı, bu unique karakteri canlandırdı ve kendi Disney+ dizisi *Forky Asks a Question?*'ı doğurdu.

## Varoluşsal Çatal-Kaşık'ın Yeni Zorluğu

**Toy Story 5**'te Bonnie'nin sevgili oyuncakları, yeni bir zorlukla karşı karşıya gelecek: akıllı teknolojinin yükselişi. Film, **Jessie** karakterinin, yeni dijital arkadaşların çekiciliği karşısında Bonnie'nin hayatında kendine yer bulma mücadelesini anlatıyor. **Greta Lee**'nin seslendirdiği **Lilypad** adlı bir iPad benzeri cihazın tanıtılmasıyla, film, teknolojinin bir çocuğun dünyasındaki oyun ve hayal gücünü nasıl etkilediğini keşfedecek. Bu yeni çatışma, arkadaşlık bağlarını ve klasik oyuncakların zamanla değişmeyen büyüsünü test edecek.

## Bir Franchise Dönüm Noktası

**Forky**'nin dönüşü ve **Toy Story** serisinin devamı, Pixar ve Disney için önemli bir章 başlangıcını simgeliyor. Seri, her zaman çocuklar ve yetişkinler için ısıtan hikayeler sunarak, animasyon sinemasının temel taşı haline geldi. **Toy Story 5**'in, *Star Wars*, *Avengers* ve *Avatar* gibi büyük franchise'lerle birlikte, potansiyel olarak gişede üç milyar dolarlık film elde edebilecek bir film olması bekleniyor. Hayranlar, bu sevgili serinin güncel temaları nasıl ele alacağını görmeyi iple çekiyor.

## Sonraki Adımlar

**Toy Story 5**, 19 Haziran 2026'da sinemalarda gösterime girecek. Hayranlar, çıkış tarihine yaklaştıkça, hikayeden ve tam seslendirme kadrosundan daha fazla ayrıntı bekleyebilirler.

content_raw: It’s hard to think of a contemporary actor more attuned to the frequency of the oddball than Tony Hale . The 55-year-old actor has spent decades on both the big and small screens channeling his expressive face and chutes-and-ladders vocal timbre into all manner of awkward, neurotic characters: Think the endlessly infantilized Buster Bluth on “Arrested Development,” or Selina Kyle’s perpetually browbeaten aide Gary Walsh on “Veep,” or even his corporate HR director in Netflix’s recent rom-com “ Office Romance .” But for a generation of kids, now, Hale will always be known as the voice of Forky, the gangly, inquisitive spork introduced in “Toy Story 4” as the latest permutation of that series’ preoccupation with the existential nature of childhood and play. Unlike the factory-pressed plastic of Buzz Lightyear or the exquisitely-sewn felt of Woody or Jessie, Forky is simply willed into existence through the confluence of pipe cleaners, popsicle sticks, and the imagination of a little girl. And Hale’s performance perfectly captures the frenetic mix of terror and curiosity that comes with, well, being born yesterday. (Disney even channeled Forky’s newfound inquisitiveness into a series of Disney+ shorts called “Forky Asks a Question?”) Six years on, Forky (and Hale) return for the Andrew Stanton-directed “ Toy Story 5 ,” which sees Bonnie’s toys reckoning with the latest danger facing the nature of play: the rise of smart technology. This time, the focus turns to Joan Cusack’s cowgirl Jessie, whose attempts to reassert her and the toys’ place in Bonnie’s life in the face of a new iPad-like device named Lilypad (voiced by Greta Lee) put her face-to-face with her own abandonment issues. Forky’s there, too, mind; he’s a bit more settled than in “4,” integrated into the rest of the gang, but also navigating the anxious early days of his marriage to fellow cutlery companion Karen Beverly (Melissa Villasenor). (You know what they say: Happy knife, happy life.) But despite Forky’s relegation to the 5,” he remains a vital part of the toybox, one that Hale keeps finding new angles to appreciate. With “Toy Story 5” now in theaters, RogerEbert.com caught up with Hale to talk about Forky’s impact on a new generation of kids, the philosophical underpinnings of being a being navigating existence, and how characters like Forky, Buster, and Gary help him process and work through his own struggles with anxiety. This interview has been edited for length and clarity. You originated the role of Forky in 2019 when “Toy Story 4” came out. How does it feel to be returning to that 6, 7 years after you took the role? That’s wild that it’s been 7 years, but if I’m honest, I was so overwhelmed the first time around.
